notes: The presentative frame's *that* goes to the apodosis waw (s017) under rule 45's second case, הָיָה keeping only *it shall come to pass*.
*to* after *hearken* is the object marker's under rule 16's first family, the preposition existing only to attach the object to the English verb.
Both articles of הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים הָאֵלֶּה are unrepresented: the phrase's one determiner is *these*, which the demonstrative pronoun takes under rule 41.
